candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Keep original symbolic anonymous-pipe contract; if no reviewed receiver/producer composition can satisfy it, stop native readiness rather than replace it with a socket or file.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Anonymous one-way bootstrap with one memory-only framing reader, producer closure and original hard byte/deadline limits.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: A byte stream or successful write is not a complete canonical authenticated envelope/EOF. Pipe capacity is not the65536byte application limit; no write-all-before-reader assumption. Retained/duplicated writers can delay EOF.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Prove complete bounded partial-read/write/EINTR/EOF handling and closure on success,malformed input,timeout,signal,producer/receiver loss before every childexec. No reread,worker RPC or local ledger.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Review another complete closure composition if this syscall/wrapper is unavailable; fail closed until equivalence is independently proved, never a blind inherited-FD fallback.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Reviewed FD allowlist plus close_range/UNSHARE or an independently race-safe closure design before every child.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: CLOEXEC is delayed until exec and numeric ranges do not identify object origin,alias,peer or lifetime. Immediate closure also needs code/interpreter/stdstream exceptions under the original policy.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Bind shared-table topology and all FDs/stdstream peers,duplicates,code objects; remove bootstrap writer,service/key/ledger/hostdir/pid/ns handles. Prove no reopen path and every nested helper policy.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Re-design a minimal externally enforced domain or reviewed stronger policy composition; if necessary backend permissions defeat isolation, record infeasibility and keep dispatch closed.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Separate reviewed mount/network/PID/capability boundaries with syscall policy, exact private paths and no worker broker reachability.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: Namespaces and seccomp isolate different surfaces. Neither their names nor a syscall allowlist prove all FD/path/cwd/env/process/alias routes or prevent external privileged writers.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Specify all namespace/mount propagation,credential/capability,device/proc,exec/interpreter,network and syscall ABI paths; demonstrate allowed backend effects and negative escapes under the full graph.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Review another complete descendant ownership/drain mechanism when required interfaces are absent; no process-name scan,parent-exit or signal-only substitute.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Supervisor-owned non-worker-mutable cgroup lifecycle plus origin-bound process descriptors/status streams and protected membership.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: A pidfd tracks one process. Empty/populated/frozen/kill or one exit status alone is not full effect,FD,storage or stream closure; migration,spawn races,supervisor loss and uninterruptible activity need explicit handling.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Prove admission into containment before any effect,all nested log/backend/rollback descendants,no migration/control leak,known exit/status/FD drain and in-flight completion on loss within original finite rights.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Review an independent trusted time/fence provider with original absolute bounds; if unavailable, no new action is eligible, even if wallclock or a finite lease appears valid.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: External trusted clock mapping and absolute original phase deadlines using a separately evaluated suspend-aware clock/timer composition.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: A local timer or BOOTTIME value supplies no issuer provenance,original boot mapping,VM rollback/clock-namespace trust,revocation serialization or durable recovery budget.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Map original finite signed bounds to independently trusted same-boot time; test suspend/resume,rollback,clock discontinuity,restart,delayed scheduling and lost timer delivery. Unknown time stops effects; deadlines never renewed.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Design a separately reviewed external mediation/enforcement architecture with complete effect coverage and no worker service capability. If that cannot coexist with real backend behavior, declare blocked rather than soften instantaneous/live requirements.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Proposed external native authority gate controls every original phase effect boundary while the worker receives only the original offline bootstrap.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: No cited generic mechanism establishes this composition. A signed offline receipt,finite lease,periodic polling,kill-on-expiry or seccomp name cannot establish atomic revocation versus every new/in-flight package/config effect.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Define trusted serialization/linearization of revocation,expiry,phase rights,effect admission and already-admitted completion. Worker has no broker FD/RPC; gate loss blocks new effects and keeps possible in-flight obligations pending.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Require proven controlled writer entrypoints or independently enforced policy with explicit trusted-administrator assumptions. Any unexcluded privileged writer or owner-loss gap blocks admission; no unlink/recreate/reacquire/force-unlock.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Compare supervisor-owned advisory coordination under proven universal cooperation with controlled-entrypoint prevention or independently enforced writer policy.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: Advisory flock alone is insufficient for manual/scheduled/privileged nonparticipants. A protected supervisor FD avoids child-unlock only if no aliases leak; owner death can release it while children still write. Private mounts do not exclude host writers to shared backing objects.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Inventory every writer in all seven original resource domains,ancestors,mount/object aliases and actual lock APIs. Prove common compatible protocol or controlled prevention before fresh capture through all consumers,recovery and known target release; unknown/nonparticipant blocks admission.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: If interfaces are unavailable, review equivalent canonical object/writer controls per platform. No reduced-security path fallback; non-provable historical loader/backend consumption blocks the graph.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Pinned reviewed directory/object handles with explicit resolution restrictions for each actual consumer and mutation.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: Resolution flags constrain one lookup; a retained read FD/hash does not freeze bytes against aliases or writers and cannot prove a later shell/interpreter/library/archive path consumes those exact bytes.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Bind ancestors,object/mount aliases,content/metadata/type/presence and all writers through actual interpreter/backend/archive consumption. Deny unsafe lookup; no realpath/check-to-later-reopen substitution.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Review a proven storage protocol/backend for each original effect; if it cannot meet durability/linearizability without retrying uncertain actions, leave readiness closed.373/374 refine owned/recovery/publication separately.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Candidate exclusive staging plus no-replace namespace commit and separately reviewed file/metadata/directory/storage ordering; service ledger requires its own linearizable transaction protocol.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: No-replace is not persistence or grant CAS. File and directory durability are separate; supported syscall/filesystem labels or exit0 do not establish the entire device/cache/VM persistence chain. Archive/checksum commits remain separate.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Bind actual filesystem,mount,device/cache/virtualization,metadata/ancestors,all writers,transaction concurrency and every intent/write/fsync/rename/directory/ACK crash cut. Unknown claim/spend/commit/ACK quarantines and never replays/refunds.

candidate_families.alternative_review_without_contract_rela: Review a new narrow successor boundary or remove incompatible candidate; do not promote a platform label/helper name or emulator behavior to native backend proof.
candidate_families.candidate_composition: Exact future source/interpreter/loader/helper/pkgtools/config/archive graph with protected bytes and a narrow backend-compatible entry.
candidate_families.limitation_and_design_inference: A syscall primitive cannot prove pkgtools selectors,hooks,raw statuses,sticky failure or boot/GenInitrd/optional-effect exclusions. Original363 dependency names/126slots and364 source anchors remain unresolved requirements.
candidate_families.required_future_native_evidence: Bind exact per-platform versions/configuration and checked-to-used identities for the whole transitive graph; prove allowed effects plus every prohibited dynamic/nested branch. No genericmain/check/dryrun/historical worker dispatch.

primary_source_review.upstream_observation: Linux5.9/glibc2.34 interface closes ranges; UNSHARE addresses shared-table races; CLOEXEC fromLinux5.11 marks for exec rather than immediate closure. Individual close errors are ignored.

primary_source_review.title: Linux kernel Seccomp BPF documentation
primary_source_review.upstream_observation: Filters inspect syscall numbers and argument values without dereferencing pointers; filtering alone is not a sandbox. Architecture checks matter; inherited child filters do not constitute full information-flow policy.

primary_source_review.retrieval_basis: Primary documentation opened successfully; no original HTML byte capture claimed.
primary_source_review.title: Linux kernel Control Group v2 documentation
primary_source_review.upstream_observation: Fork inherits current cgroup membership; processes can migrate. Freezing is asynchronous and status is reported in cgroup.events. cgroup.kill targets the descendant tree with SIGKILL.

primary_source_review.title: Linux man-pages pidfd_open(2)
primary_source_review.upstream_observation: A PID descriptor can be polled for the referenced process exit.

primary_source_review.title: Linux man-pages timerfd_create(2)
primary_source_review.upstream_observation: CLOCK_BOOTTIME timerfd support fromLinux3.15 includes suspend time; CLOCK_MONOTONIC excludes it. CLOCK_REALTIME is affected by discontinuous clock changes.

primary_source_review.retrieval_basis: Indexed primary manual excerpt; direct open timed out.
primary_source_review.title: Linux man-pages flock(2)
primary_source_review.upstream_observation: Local advisory flock can be ignored by a writer with access. Duplicates share the open-file-description lock and can unlock it; final closure releases it. Remote filesystem semantics differ.

primary_source_review.retrieval_basis: Indexed primary manual excerpt; direct open timed out.
primary_source_review.title: Linux man-pages openat2(2)
primary_source_review.upstream_observation: Linux5.6 resolution flags can reject beneath-root escapes, magic links and mount crossings. Explicit NO_MAGICLINKS avoids reliance on current BENEATH side effects.

primary_source_review.retrieval_basis: Indexed primary full manual returned; no original HTML byte capture claimed.
primary_source_review.title: Linux man-pages fsync(2)
primary_source_review.upstream_observation: File fsync flushes data and metadata but does not by itself persist the containing directory entry; explicit directory fsync is also needed. Errors include EIO and ENOSPC.

primary_source_review.upstream_observation: RENAME_NOREPLACE rejects an existing destination and requires filesystem support; ext4 support startsLinux3.15, btrfs/tmpfs/cifs3.17, xfs4.0, several others4.9.
